heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of a shower or sprinkle, mainly far south, and in New York. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy. A rising chance of showers north, becoming likely in the St. Lawrence Valley by midnight, and spreading south to around Route 2 late. Lows from the upper 50s to mid 60s. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley, diminishing after midnight.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly cloudy north, with showers likely. Increasing clouds south, with a rising chance south, except slight chance in southeastern valleys. Highs in the mid to upper 60s north, and upper 60s to mid 70s in the south. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming northwest in the afternoon.
